# `update_source`

Write new ABAP source code to an existing object (acquires lock, PUTs source, releases lock)

Defined in [`packages/adt-mcp/src/lib/tools/update-source.ts`](https://github.com/abapify/adt-cli/blob/main/packages/adt-mcp/src/lib/tools/update-source.ts).

## Input schema

| Parameter         | Type                         | Required         | Description                                                                                                    |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------- | ---------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `baseUrl`         | `string`                     | no               | SAP system base URL (e.g. https://host:8000)                                                                   |
| `client`          | `string`                     | no               | SAP client number                                                                                              |
| `username`        | `string`                     | no               | Username for basic auth                                                                                        |
| `password`        | `string`                     | no               | Password for basic auth                                                                                        |
| `systemId`        | `string`                     | no               | Logical system id (resolved via the server multi-system configuration)                                         |
| `objectName`      | `string`                     | yes              | ABAP object name                                                                                               |
| `objectType`      | `string`                     | no               | Object type (e.g. PROG, CLAS, INTF)                                                                            |
| `action`          | `"update"` \| `"editMethod"` | no               | Write mode: update writes full source; editMethod replaces one method body inside a class Default: `"update"`. |
| `methodName`      | `string`                     | no               | Method name to replace when action=editMethod                                                                  |
| `sourceCode`      | `string`                     | yes              | New ABAP source code                                                                                           |
| `lintBeforeWrite` | `boolean`                    | no               | When true, run local abaplint pre-check and block write on parser/cloud violations Default: `false`.           |
| `lintPreset`      | `"btp"` \| `"onpremise"`     | no               | Lint preset for lintBeforeWrite gate (btp enables cloud_types checking)                                        |
| `transport`       | `string`                     | no               | Transport request number (required for transportable objects)                                                  |
| `destination`     | `string`                     | destination mode | Required when the server runs in destination mode; an ADT destination key matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]\{1,62\}$`. |

_In destination mode every call additionally requires a `destination` key and rejects the connection fields (`baseUrl`, `client`, `username`, `password`, `systemId`)._

## Output

The tool returns a single text content item whose body is a JSON-serialised object (`content[0].text`). On error, the response has `isError: true` and a human-readable message.

```json
{
  "content": [{ "type": "text", "text": "<JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)>" }]
}
```

See the source for the exact shape of `result`.

## Example invocation

```json
{
  "name": "update_source",
  "arguments": {
    "baseUrl": "https://sap.example.com:44300",
    "username": "DEVELOPER",
    "password": "***",
    "client": "100",
    "objectName": "<objectName>",
    "sourceCode": "<sourceCode>"
  }
}
```
